name: se.agendan/agendan
title: Agendan
description: Things to do in Sweden: events, venues, areas and boards from agendan.se. Read-only, no key.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description:
Search things to do in Sweden on Agendan: concerts, theatre, markets, exhibitions, activities for children and more. Only upcoming and ongoing events are returned.

Use it for questions like "what's on this weekend near Malmö for a family with kids": place "Malmö", when "weekend", audience ["kids-family"].

Give the time with when ("today", "tonight", "tomorrow", "weekend", "week" or "next-week"): Agendan computes the window in Swedish time, the same as agendan.se, so you do not need to. Use from and to only for other dates.

Each result has a webUrl. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan". Use get_event for the full description, all occurrences and the sources.

q.description: Free text, matched against title, venue, tags and description. Swedish words work best (e.g. "jazz", "julmarknad", "loppis").

place.description: A Swedish place by name, such as "Malmö", "Södermalm" or "Österlen". It is looked up like search_areas, and its position and radius are used. Do not combine with lat and lng. The result names the area that was used (place).

lat.description: Latitude (WGS 84) to search around. Requires lng. Rounded to about 1 km.

radius.description: Radius in km around the position (place or lat/lng). With place, the area's own radius is used when this is left out.

autoRadius.description: Choose the radius from what is on around the position, like agendan.se. On by default with place.

when.description: The time window, as on agendan.se, in Swedish time. "today": now to midnight. "tonight": events starting 17:00–04:00 with a known time (before 04:00, the evening before). "tomorrow": the whole day. "weekend": Friday 17:00 to Monday 00:00 ("this weekend"). "week": now to Monday 00:00 ("this week"). "next-week": Monday to Monday. Not with from, to or startsWithin.

from.description: Start of the time window, for dates that when does not cover: a day (YYYY-MM-DD) or a date and time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, Swedish time when no zone is given).

to.description: End of the time window. A day includes the whole day, a date and time is exclusive.

startsWithin.description: Only events whose next occurrence starts inside the from–to window, with a known time. Requires to. when "tonight" already does this.

audience.description: Only events for any of these audiences. "kids-family" for children and families. Events for everyone always match.

category.description: Only these categories. Any of them matches.

type.description: "event": with occurrences. "ongoing": on during a period, such as an exhibition.

venue.description: Only events at this venue (id from search_venues).

sort.description: "time" (default), "distance" (needs a position), "relevance" (needs q) or "recommended": the order of Recommended on agendan.se, the most notable nearby and soon first. With recommended the first 20 events may have a label ("dont-miss", "last-chance" or "odd"): show it as "Don't miss", "Last chance" or "Unusual".

perPage.description: Results per page, at most 20 (the default).

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event on Agendan by id (from search_events, get_board or get_organizer): description, all occurrences, the venue, prices and tickets, organizers and the sources. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan". Link to the source as well.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search places to go to in Sweden: museums, theatres, bathing places, nature reserves, playgrounds and more. Give q (the name), a position (place or lat/lng), or both. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan". Show the attribution (for example OpenStreetMap) that comes with the result.

place.description: A Swedish place by name, such as "Malmö", "Södermalm" or "Österlen". It is looked up like search_areas, and its position and radius are used. Do not combine with lat and lng. The result names the area that was used (place).

lat.description: Latitude (WGS 84) to search around. Requires lng. Rounded to about 1 km.

radius.description: Radius in km around the position (place or lat/lng). With place, the area's own radius is used when this is left out.

group.description: Only these groups of venue kinds, for example "bathing" or "family".

perPage.description: Results per page, at most 20 (the default).

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: One venue by id (from search_venues or an event's location): address, position, kind, links and the number of upcoming events. Use search_events with venue for what is on there. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan". Show its attribution.

tools.name: search_areas
tools.description: Find Swedish areas by name: localities, districts, municipalities, counties, provinces and regions such as Österlen. Each has a position and a radius to search around. Use it when a place name is ambiguous, then pass lat, lng and radius to the other tools. Show the attribution that comes with the result.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Boards are collections of events on Agendan, such as "Christmas markets in Skåne", made by the editors or shared by users. Lists Agendan's own boards, and with a position (place or lat/lng) public boards nearby, or a venue's boards. Use get_board for the events on a board. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan".

place.description: A Swedish place by name, such as "Malmö", "Södermalm" or "Österlen". It is looked up like search_areas, and its position and radius are used. Do not combine with lat and lng. The result names the area that was used (place).

lat.description: Latitude (WGS 84) to search around. Requires lng. Rounded to about 1 km.

radius.description: Radius in km around the position (place or lat/lng). With place, the area's own radius is used when this is left out.

venue.description: Only boards that this venue is on. Not with a position.

perPage.description: Results per page, at most 20 (the default).

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: One board by slug (from list_boards) with a page of its events. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan".

lat.description: Rank the board's events from this position. Requires lng.

perPage.description: Results per page, at most 20 (the default).

tools.name: get_organizer
tools.description: An organizer or performer by id (from an event's actors): name, city, links and upcoming events. Always show webUrl (the page on agendan.se) with each item and say "via Agendan".
